scope: The initial complete local browser run reported eight passing scenarios and three failures. Its original complete JSON report was overwritten by a subsequent run. This file summarizes only the known findings preserved in the execution transcript; it is not a reconstruction of the original report.

findings.observation: After expanding the collection records, document.scrollWidth was 321 for a 320px viewport. A rotated av-expand element reached x=320.61968994140625.
findings.resolution: The page owner corrected compounded mobile container gutters and narrow layout sizing. The subsequent complete run passed the 320px layout checks.

findings.observation: The harness queried a global noscript locator, which matched both the page guidance and a shared-layout element. Playwright rejected the ambiguous locator.
findings.resolution: The harness now selects the page's av-nojs guidance directly. The subsequent complete run passed the no-JavaScript evidence checks.

findings.observation: All verification failure and cached-snapshot assertions completed, but the strict console-error check found six shared resources unavailable after offline navigation.
findings.resolution: The harness permits only these exact resource URLs with expected offline network-error codes in that scenario and records every observed exception. Shared caching remains outside this workstream; these offline limitations were not repaired or hidden.
